title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: OpenClaw Trajectory Specialist - 65130
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical business problems.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly analytical professionals to join as S3 Annotators , responsible for producing and validating advanced OpenClaw trajectories for research-oriented tasks involving ambiguous goals, multi-step reasoning, and long-context workflows.


This role requires strong problem-solving ability, research thinking, and the capability to justify decisions while executing complex, multi-tool workflows used to train sophisticated AI agents.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and validate OpenClaw trajectories for complex, research-oriented tasks
  • Work on tasks such as data analysis, web research, and document synthesis
  • Operate under underspecified or ambiguous goals , making logical and defensible decisions
  • Use Python (notebooks, scripts) for data processing, automation, and analysis
  • Perform workflows spanning multiple tools, environments, and applications
  • Clearly document both what actions were taken and why they were taken
  • Review and improve trajectory quality for reasoning depth and correctness
  • Collaborate with teams to refine evaluation standards and annotation frameworks


Requirements:

  • Background in research, data science, engineering, or related fields (academic or industry)
  • 5+ years of experience in Python / Bash , including experience with notebooks and data wrangling
  • Experience with OpenClaw or similar advanced environments
  • Experience with web research, scraping tools, or data analysis workflows
  • Ability to articulate reasoning behind decisions and steps
  • Experience handling multi-step workflows across tools or platforms
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows


Nice to Have:

  • Academic research experience (thesis, publications, lab work )
  • Familiarity with evaluation methodologies or experimental design
  • Experience in AI evaluation, RLHF, or advanced annotation workflows


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 5 weeks; (expected start date is next week).
  • Location: Remote (India, Brazil, Mexico, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Turkey)


Evaluation Process:

  • Resume screening
  • Take home assessment (60 mins)



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Executivo(a) Comercial | Feira de Santana - Bahia | Liora Energia
description:
Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.


A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.


Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.


Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
  • Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
  • Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.


O que Buscamos em Você:

description:
CHAMADA ÚNICA – BOOTCAMP SAP CCS|PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO


Não perca a oportunidade de fazer parte de um Programa de Capacitação exclusivo para um processo de seleção do BOOTCAMP SAP CCS - Customer Care & Service.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.


Participação: Formação Custeada Integralmente

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

What We Offer:

You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. description:

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

title: Content Operations Specialist
description:

Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, , social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.


What You Will Do


Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).

description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.



Sobre a Oportunidade:


Você tem interesse em tecnologia, sustentabilidade e soluções energéticas inovadoras? Esta é uma oportunidade para quem deseja atuar na fronteira da transição energética, desenvolvendo tecnologias que impulsionam a economia circular e reduzem impactos ambientais.

Buscamos um profissional com visão integrada e capacidade analítica para desenvolver e validar uma solução tecnológica de segunda vida para baterias de íon-lítio, conectando hardware, software e protocolos avançados de segurança. Seu trabalho envolverá desde a avaliação técnica das baterias até a construção de sistemas inteligentes para seu uso em aplicações de armazenamento estacionário de energia.

Mais do que uma função técnica, trata-se de um papel estratégico — voltado à inovação sustentável, análise de viabilidade econômica, desenvolvimento de protótipos, integração de tecnologias digitais e construção de soluções escaláveis que contribuam diretamente para a transição energética no país.

Se você busca um desafio que una tecnologia, impacto ambiental positivo e visão de futuro, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções energéticas mais limpas, seguras e economicamente viáveis, esta oportunidade é para você.



Projeto:

Desenvolvimento de Tecnologias para a Segunda Vida de Baterias usadas em Veículos Elétricos e Híbridos


Formação:

Doutorado em Engenharia Elétrica, Ciência de Dados, eletroquímica ou áreas correlatas.


Idioma: inglês técnico basico


Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).


Principais Atividades:


  • Desenvolver e validar uma solução tecnológica de segunda vida para baterias de íon-lítio.
  • Integrar hardware, software e protocolos de segurança em um sistema completo e confiável.
  • Adaptar as baterias recondicionadas para aplicações de armazenamento estacionário de energia.
  • Promover economia circular por meio do reaproveitamento de baterias descartadas pela indústria automotiva e outros setores.
  • Reduzir impactos ambientais relacionados ao descarte e à produção de novos materiais.
  • Avaliar e garantir a viabilidade econômica da solução dentro do contexto da transição energética.
  • Contribuir para o avanço de tecnologias sustentáveis e para o fortalecimento do ecossistema de energia limpa no país.


Conhecimentos e habilidades necessários:


  • Eletromobilidade e suas aplicações tecnológicas.
  • Baterias de íon-lítio, incluindo funcionamento, degradação e reuso.
  • Machine Learning aplicado à energia, para análise, predição e otimização de desempenho.
  • Desenvolvimento de hardware embarcado, incluindo sensores, microcontroladores e sistemas de monitoramento.
  • Integração de sistemas de energia, com foco em eficiência, segurança e interoperabilidade.



Conhecimentos e habilidades desejáveis:

  • Liderança em Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I), com capacidade de conduzir projetos técnicos e interdisciplinares.
  • Trabalho colaborativo em ecossistemas de inovação, envolvendo empresas, universidades, laboratórios e parceiros tecnológicos.
  • Visão estratégica de mercado, alinhando soluções tecnológicas às tendências, demandas e oportunidades do setor energético.

The AI Engineer – Integrations & Automation will design, build, and maintain AI‑driven automations and integrations that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of AI platforms, internal systems, and business workflows. This is a remote position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Automation of complex workflows: Design, build, and maintain automated processes leveraging tools such as Zapier, Glean , or custom Python-based automation frameworks .
  • Systems integration: Develop, implement, and document internal APIs to connect AI services with existing enterprise applications (e.g., Google Workspace, Salesforce, internal SaaS platforms ).
  • Agentic infrastructure: Integrate platforms such as Glean, OpenAI, and Perplexity into operational pipelines to enable multi‑agent orchestration and intelligent decisioning.
  • Cross-functional delivery: Partner with Finance, HR, Editorial, Events , and other teams to translate operational needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Scalable solutions: Propose and implement integration architectures that reduce manual workflows, increase efficiency, and ensure long‑term reliability.
  • Documentation & knowledge transfer: Maintain detailed technical documentation of workflows, decision logic, and system connections for internal knowledge sharing.
  • Future-proofing: Evaluate emerging AI and LLM tooling to identify opportunities for continuous improvement of enterprise operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong experience with Python and at least one automation / integration platform (e.g., Zapier, n8n, custom orchestration frameworks).
  • Proven background building APIs, integrations, or backend services that connect multiple SaaS systems.
  • Hands-on exposure to LLM / AI platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication , and event-driven architectures.
  • Ability to work directly with non‑technical stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver usable solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Glean (search, knowledge, and/or agentic workflows).
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace and Google Cloud tools (e.g., BigQuery , Vertex AI, or similar).
  • Experience with Claude or other state-of-the-art LLMs.
  • Experience in enterprise environments (identity, security, compliance).
  • Prior work with multi‑agent systems , RAG pipelines, or observability for AI workflows

title: Back-End Developer Project (.Net / C#)
description:

  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon Kinesis
  • Amazon Kinesis Firehose
  • Amazon S3


Additional Information

title: Integration Analyst
description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.

  • Atuar em times Agile , participando de cerimônias Scrum e/ou SAFe.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos com desenvolvimento .NET (C#) .
  • Vivência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou SAFe).
  • Experiência comprovada com Azure Cloud , incluindo:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Certificação AZ-104 – Azure Administrator .
  • Experiência com controle de versão (Git/GitHub) e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT).
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unit e integration tests).
  • Aplicação consistente de Clean Code , Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Product Manager Sênior — Política de Estoque (Multi-Canal)
description:
Sobre a posição:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a estratégia e evolução do nosso produto de Política de Estoque.

Esse produto atua no coração da operação, determinando metas e regras de alocação de estoque por canal (ex: e-commerce, lojas), equilibrando trade-offs entre disponibilidade, margem, giro e experiência do cliente.

Mais do que gerenciar regras, essa posição será responsável por evoluir um sistema de decisão complexo, baseado em dados, capaz de responder dinamicamente. Você atuará na interseção entre negócio, supply chain e tecnologia, com alto impacto nos principais indicadores da companhia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Definir e liderar a visão do produto de Política de Estoque , estruturando como decisões de alocação são tomadas e evoluem ao longo do tempo;
  • Desenhar e evoluir modelos de decisão para definição de metas de estoque por canal , considerando demanda, capacidade logística, estratégia comercial e restrições operacionais;
  • Transformar regras estáticas e conhecimento tácito em sistemas escaláveis , explícitos e mensuráveis;
  • Conduzir discovery em problemas altamente ambíguos , estruturando hipóteses e identificando os principais drivers de decisão;
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs como disponibilidade, ruptura, cobertura, giro, margem e impacto por canal;
  • Explorar dados para identificar padrões, conflitos e oportunidades de otimização entre canais;
  • Conduzir experimentos e simulações para validar decisões antes de escalar;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de Dados e Engenharia na construção de pipelines, regras e modelos;
  • Priorizar roadmap com base em impacto sistêmico, considerando trade-offs entre áreas;
  • Comunicar claramente decisões, critérios e impactos, garantindo transparência e confiança no sistema.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em produtos complexos e orientados a dados;
  • Experiência com problemas de alocação, otimização, supply chain, pricing ou sistemas de decisão;
  • Forte capacidade de estruturar problemas ambíguos e transformá-los em modelos claros de decisão;
  • Capacidade de navegar e mediar conflitos entre áreas com objetivos distintos;
  • Experiência com definição e análise de métricas de negócio e operacionais;
  • Vivência com experimentação, simulação ou validação de hipóteses em ambientes complexos;
  • Experiência trabalhando próximo a times de Dados e Engenharia em soluções escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e orientada a impacto;
  • Capacidade de influenciar sem autoridade formal em ambientes politicamente complexos.


Diferenciais Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com estoque, supply chain, planejamento de demanda ou logística omnichannel;
  • Conhecimento em modelos de otimização, forecast ou algoritmos de decisão;
  • Familiaridade com SQL, Python ou ferramentas analíticas;
  • Experiência em e-commerce, varejo ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência prévia com sistemas multi-canal e conflitos de alocação.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que define como o estoque — um dos ativos mais críticos da companhia — é distribuído e monetizado.

Cada decisão impacta diretamente venda, margem, eficiência operacional e experiência do cliente.

Aqui, não existe resposta óbvia: você estará constantemente equilibrando trade-offs entre canais, áreas e objetivos, em um sistema dinâmico e de alta complexidade.

É uma oportunidade de construir um produto de decisão estratégico, com impacto transversal em toda a operação.
