title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Multimodalto help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.What You'll Do 1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding. Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching. Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities. Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references. Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions. 3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement. 4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics. Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.Who We're Looking For 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text. Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models. Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.2. Highly valued experience RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks. Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent). Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion. Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems. Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models. Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Finance Manager
description: About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations. Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards. Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready. Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent. Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ. Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners. Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries. Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.Requirements Experience:Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution. Technical Knowledge:Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations. Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines. Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis. Education:Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus. Language Skills:Fluency inEnglish and Portugueseis mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators. Crypto Proficiency:Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description: Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.We are activelyscreening thousands of top students globallyto identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered inpartnership with leading boutique investment banksin key markets, includingthe US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarterfor this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling Sourcing & Due Diligence Industry and Company Research And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals. Mentorship & Feedback:Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.Who We're Looking For: This program is ideal for highly motivated1st year and 2nd year students(not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who arehungry, quick learners, and committedto excelling in a fast-paced environment.How to Apply: Get your application in now!If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase. This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Gerente De Investigação Forense
description: Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo. title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3. Project Delivery Timeliness Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines. Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishReady for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce DeveloperImportant Information Location:Brazil Job Mode:Full-time Work Mode:Work from homeJob SummaryWe are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).Responsibilities and DutiesLead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;
Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.Essential SkillsExperience with Salesforce development;
Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.Highly Desirable SkillsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Coding Agentsto help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients. This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.What You'll Do: 1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes. Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR). Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works. Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.G., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions. Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience. Python proficiency required;
proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred. Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss. Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.2. Highly valued experience Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools. Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent). RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design. Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems. Comfort with SQL and structured data workflowsWhy Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Remote Ai Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.Role Overview:As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.Key Qualifications: Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 3 monthsAfter applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Finance Manager
description: About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards. Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready. Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent. Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ. Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners. Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries. Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.Requirements Experience:Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution. Technical Knowledge:Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations. Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines. Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis. Education:Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus. Language Skills:Fluency inEnglish and Portugueseis mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators. Crypto Proficiency:Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

description: About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. Language Skills:Fluency inEnglish and Portugueseis mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators. title: Ai & Innovation Experience Designer
description: AI & Innovation Experience DesignerAbout the Role We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.What You'll Do Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys. Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools. Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle. Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership. Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environmentsPreferred Qualifications Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystemThis role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you're excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we'd love to connect.

title: Tech Lead - Java
description:
Quem somos nós?Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica paraescalar resultadose aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção desoluções inovadorase disruptivas emmais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionaisde múltiplos segmentos.Nosso propósito éimpactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos umespaço aberto e livrepara você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas egerar mudanças ao seu redor .Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:Contratação:CLT Modelo de Trabalho:Remoto Horário:das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. Etapas do Processo:Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra. Meios de Comunicação:Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.O que buscamos?Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes.Como será seu dia-a-dia?Liderança técnica:Fornece liderança e orientação técnica à equipe de desenvolvimento, estabelecendo padrões de qualidade, aderindo às melhores práticas e garantindo a implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis;
Compreensão do fluxo devalor:Trabalha com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender o fluxo de valor completo, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto, identificando áreas de melhoria e reduzindo desperdícios no processo;
Colaboração com equipesmultifuncionais:Trabalha em estreita colaboração com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender as necessidades dos negócios, traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do projeto e do cliente;
Gerenciamento de projetos e entregas:Monitora o progresso dos projetos, identifique gargalos e proponha soluções para garantir que os prazos e os padrões de qualidade sejam cumpridos. Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
Planejamento e design técnico:Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria;
Entrega contínua de valor:Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
Desenvolvimento e revisão de código : Desenvolve acompanha o desenvolvimento de integrações e APIs, fornecendo orientações técnicas e conduzindo revisões de código para garantir a qualidade e a aderência às normas e práticas recomendadas;
Mentoria e desenvolvimento da equipe:Promove o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da equipe de desenvolvimento por meio de mentoria, compartilhamento de conhecimento e promoção de um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo. Isso inclui a realização de sessões de treinamento, fornecendo feedback construtivo e apoiando a resolução de problemas complexos;
Medição e melhoria de resultados:Utiliza métricas e indicadores relevantes para avaliar o sucesso das soluções entregues, identificar áreas de melhoria e garantir a satisfação das partes interessadas;
Comunicação e apresentação de resultados:Comunica-se efetivamente com as partes interessadas em todos os níveis da organização, incluindo a apresentação de resultados, o compartilhamento de atualizações de projetos e a discussão de questões técnicas e de negócios.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação e frameworks relevantes para o domínio do projeto (por exemplo: Java, .NET, JavaScript, Python, etc.), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos e soluções em ambientes empresariais;
Experiência em desenvolvimento e design de APIs, incluindo o uso de padrões como REST, SOAP e gRPC;
Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
Experiência com práticas de integração de sistemas, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), SOA (Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços) e iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service);
Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados;
Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI;
Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos;
Domínio em automação detestes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras;
Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e APIs, incluindo autenticação, autorização, criptografia e conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes;
Experiência em gerenciamento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, como AWS, Azure e Google Cloud Platform;
Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento de aplicativos.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso? Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:Principais Responsabilidades: - Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;
- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;
- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;
- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;
- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;
- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.Habilidades Técnicas: - Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);
- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);
- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);
- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.Js, Angular, Next.Js);
- Experiência em .NET edesenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);
- Capacidade de aplicarpadrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);
- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);
- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);
- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);
- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;
- Habilidade em liderardecisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.O que você encontra aqui: Remote First– Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida.
